# CodeFronts Bento Pricing Grid

The Pricing layout adapts the grid-area approach from [Bento Pricing Grid](https://codefronts.com/layouts/css-pricing-sections/bento-pricing-grid/), published by CodeFronts under the MIT license, free for commercial use. The original is a four-column named-area grid that stacks at smaller widths. Toza retains the layout approach and adapts its visual treatment, content and structure to its own services.
